scope: RockPro CAD frontend MVP: project card, stages, parameters, snapshot history

rules.check: Create project with stable identifier, customer, request and source path; reload in new process and compare saved values.
Two projects retain separate source paths, stages and histories.
Project list and detail reflect committed edits; failed save remains visible as failure.
Stage progress denotes recorded human workflow state, not a completed automated CAD check.
Missing-backend and disconnected-backend are distinct; planned functionality cannot imply live capability.
Selected project source is explicit. An unrelated active document must not be mutated.
rules.evidence: code review and serial live inspection

rules.check: Parameter change creates a new ICS revision, validates geometry and reopening, verifies original unchanged.
rules.evidence: live report with source/copy identities and hashes

rules.check: Invalid numbers, unknown parameters and physically impossible dimensions are rejected before mutation.
Failed snapshot is not listed as successful and never becomes latest source.
History persists and associates each revision with its project, parent, path, timestamp and operation.
History does not conflate file existence with valid ICS; reopen/geometry checks gate success.
Native frontend and MCP use the same backend and database, with no separate divergent project state.
JSON-RPC stdout contains only JSON lines and calls expose actionable errors.
Project, stages, parameters and history are reachable with clear current selection.
Long tables have independent resizable windows with scrolling and explicit titles.
Action buttons have tooltips, disabled/busy state and confirmation/result feedback.
At normal and reduced window sizes no essential action or status is clipped.
Backend-unavailable message is not replaced by fake sample data; retry exists.
Logo, readable hierarchy, consistent spacing and status text work without relying solely on color.
CAD operations do not freeze the message loop; concurrent operation is prevented.
rules.evidence: async code review and live operation
